I found this [ example
](https://github.com/ros2/examples/blob/humble/rclcpp/actions/minimal_action_client/member_functions.cpp)
and I realized that the class `
rclcpp_action::ClientGoalHandle<T>::WrappedResult ` already has the attribute

rclcpp_action::ResultCode::ABORTED ` or ` rclcpp_action::ResultCode::CANCELLED
` ) so there is no need of putting this information in the action interface.
